blocks.goal: Extract the repetitive lock/unlock usage into a small helper class and update Parser to use it so Parser is smaller and has less duplicated locking logic.

ops.details: Create a new helper class org.jsoup.parser.ParserUtils with a single public static generic method <T> T withLock(java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantLock lock, java.util.concurrent.Callable<T> callable) that acquires the lock, calls callable.call(), unlocks in finally, and rethrows exceptions as RuntimeException. Place the class in the same package org.jsoup.parser.

Replace the explicit try { lock.lock(); return treeBuilder.parse(inputHtml, baseUri, this); } finally { lock.unlock(); } in the public Document parseInput(Reader inputHtml, String baseUri) method with: return ParserUtils.withLock(lock, () -> treeBuilder.parse(inputHtml, baseUri, this)); Keep method signature and visibility unchanged. No change to public API.

Replace the explicit try { lock.lock(); return treeBuilder.parseFragment(fragment, context, baseUri, this); } finally { lock.unlock(); } in the public List<Node> parseFragmentInput(Reader fragment, @Nullable Element context, String baseUri) method with: return ParserUtils.withLock(lock, () -> treeBuilder.parseFragment(fragment, context, baseUri, this)); Keep method signature and visibility unchanged. No change to public API.
